title: Payment Deductions or Loss during Payment Entry Not Allowed -- Sometimes -- v16

posts.cooked:
Hello all,

This feels like a BUG because it seem to work sometimes and not other times.

User is entering a payment to pay a Sales Invoice for a customer.
User enters a small amount as CC Processing fee under Payment Deductions or Loss section.
Did “Preview Accounting Ledger” it looks good 3 entries debit/credit amounts equal in total.

Get this Message
Payment Entry ACC-PAY-2026-00256: Either debit or credit amount is required for 1110 - AR-Trade - CG

The thing is it only does this sometimes. Most of the time it works.
Why?

Thanks for your help
